Daru Dictionary: four bar words, one reel. 🥃

Neat, on the rocks, a splash, highball. Now you can order like Large Sahab.

Which one is yours? Comment below. And save this for your next order.

Water between pegs. Never drink and drive.

#DaruDictionary #LargeSahab #EkLarge #WhiskyLovers

scenes.label: WORD 1 OF 4
scenes.title: Neat.
scenes.body: Straight from the bottle. No ice, no water.

scenes.label: WORD 2 OF 4
scenes.title: On the rocks.
scenes.body: Poured over ice. Colder, and it slowly mellows.

scenes.label: WORD 3 OF 4
scenes.title: A splash.
scenes.body: A few drops of water. It opens up the aroma.

scenes.label: WORD 4 OF 4
scenes.title: Highball.
scenes.body: Whisky, plenty of soda and ice, in a tall glass.
